name: Bazaar - AI Agent Marketplace (Fetch.ai)
tagline: A marketplace where AI agents negotiate tasks and get paid on-chain only after independent verification.

awards: Best use of ASI:One Presented by Fetch.Ai

problem: There is no way to trust an agent completed work before paying it.
solution: Client agents find and negotiate with tool agents; payment releases only after a separate verification step, with blockchain settlement.
demo_moment: Team-described: an agent hires another, the work is verified, payment settles.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of ASI:One Presented by Fetch.Ai” among 122 submissions.

lessons: Trust is the missing primitive in agent marketplaces.
